name: hero-ai-value-proposition

frames.best_why: Headline, pitch, button, avatar row and the top of the mockup are all visible together.

tagline: Centred headline, black pill button, avatar row and a big app mockup.
summary: A light landing hero with a centred two-line headline, short pitch, one black call to action and a row of designer faces. A product mockup of a brief builder rises beneath it.
appearance: A near-white page boxed by thin grey rules. Two heavy lines of black type sit above a grey paragraph and a black pill button; beneath are five overlapping round portraits and a small blue count pill. A wide white card with a soft shadow rises at the bottom, showing a brief-builder screen with placeholder bars.
behaviour: As the page scrolls into view the header, headline, paragraph, button and each avatar fade in one after another. The mockup then rises into place, revealing its selected 'Web app' tile with a pointer cursor; unselected tiles stay greyed and colour on hover.
demo_content: Headline 'AI-generated project briefs built for designers', 'Join 80,000+ designers' and a brief-builder mockup.
search_phrases: light hero for an ai design tool
centered headline with avatar social proof
product mockup below the call to action
light saas landing page above the fold
app screenshot peeking from bottom of hero
one big button under a long headline
use_when: A design or AI tool page wants a calm light hero with social proof and a product preview.
avoid_when: The preview is decorative placeholder bars, and all copy plus 78 colours are fixed in the JSX.
customise: All copy, avatar photos and the mockup markup sit in the JSX; only colours on the cards and glows can be changed in place.
weight_why: One staggered reveal of text and images; nothing animates after it settles.

a11y.note: The four project-type tiles are clickable divs with no role or tab stop, and the reveal ignores reduced motion.

issues: Project-type tiles are plain divs, so keyboard users cannot reach them.
The product preview is filled with grey placeholder bars, not real text.
Avatar images carry empty alt text.
polish_why: Crisp editorial grid and a believable product preview; the placeholder bars are thin.
